title: Verify work-order loop v2
objective: Inspect the work-order policy and tests, run the declared work-order test suite, and record integrity hashes without modifying repository files.
constraints: Do not propose apply_patch or write_file steps.
Use only the exact declared test command.
Do not access network resources other than the configured local provider.
acceptance: The provider returns a schema-valid version 2 plan.
Only declared files are read or hashed.
The exact work-order test command exits with code 0.
The final checkpoint records completed step IDs and validation evidence.
